commitments.target: Target a $100 million business in the electronic and specialty chemical segment in 3-4 years.
commitments.quote: And in the period of 3-4 years, as we said, we try to target a $100 million business in this segment, the niche area.
commitments.speaker: Mayank Singhal

commitments.target: Guidance has been between 50%-52% odd margin there.
commitments.quote: But our guidance has been between 50%-52% odd margin there.
commitments.speaker: Mayank Singhal

claims.claim: Ag chem exports declined by 18% during the period due to price optimization and unpassed cost escalation.
claims.quote: Ag Chem exports declined by 18% during the period. We remained focused on driving volume growth post-genericization through price optimization while cost escalation could not be passed through in this current market conditions.

claims.claim: Domestic agri business grew 19% year-on-year supported by differentiated products and biologicals.
claims.quote: Our domestic business continues to hold its ground with strong year-on-year growth of 19% despite the challenging market dynamics, supported by a portfolio of differentiated high-value crop protection solutions and strong market position across key brands.

claims.claim: Domestic biologicals portfolio grew by 45% and global portfolio saw over 250% growth this quarter.
claims.quote: Our domestic portfolio has grown by 45% and our global portfolio has seen more than 250% growth this quarter as farmers continue to adopt sustainable solutions.

claims.claim: Pharma business grew 20% year-on-year supported by deepening customer engagement.
claims.quote: Our pharma business grew 20% year-on-year supported by deepening engagement with customers showing early shoots and building development & manufacturing capabilities.

claims.claim: Reduced net working capital by 18 days and released Rs. 298 crores of cash.
claims.quote: Keeping business hygiene a priority, we reduce net working capital by 18 days, releasing Rs. 298 crores of cash as at quarter end.

claims.claim: New molecules account for 16% to 18% of the Ag Chem exports business.
claims.quote: All the new molecules which we have been commercializing, account for 16% to 18% of our Ag Chem exports business and it can vary on quarter to quarter basis, but on a yearly basis, it is around 16% to 18%.

analyst_concerns.question: Could you break down the export revenue between pharma, biologics, and agrochemical CSM?
analyst_concerns.quote: Would be possible to just help us with the breakdown between these three buckets because we are not exactly able to back into the biologics number.

analyst_concerns.question: What is the normalized level of margins expected on gross and EBITDA margin sides?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, what is the normalized level of margins that we expect you know and yes, both on the gross margin side and the EBITDA margin side if you could just share your perspective there.

analyst_concerns.question: Could you share the order book number?
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir, my first question is if you could share the order book number?

analyst_concerns.question: Are patented molecules also facing pricing pressure?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, is it fair to believe now that even the patented molecules are also kind of facing pricing pressure, which was not the case earlier, which was only restricted to generic products?
